aspect_scores.evidence: Six reviews praise spotless or thorough housekeeping, but three report mustiness, mold and an uncleaned room.
Many guests found staff warm and helpful, but others report slow check-in, an unanswered phone and a front desk that did nothing about noise.
Praise for cinnamon rolls, coffee and pastries sits against complaints of minimal food, running out by eight and few hot options.
Comfortable beds are praised, but guests also report a dated or tired room, a rattling or broken heater and a damp carpet.
One guest called it great value for a harbor town in season; another found it disappointing for the price.
Guests praise being walkable to the docks and marina and right by the water, with no complaints.
Three guests found rooms quiet; three report thin walls, hallway sound or noisy neighbors until 2am.
Both reviews say parking is limited, with one calling it a nightmare and the other tight but manageable.
Both reviews report wifi problems, with evening dropouts and slowness for work calls.
Guests praise the harbor views, sunsets and Northern Michigan charm; one guest booked a lakeview room and got a parking lot view.

actions.title: Service and replace faulty heaters and treat damp rooms

actions.title: Upgrade wifi so evening calls and streaming stay connected
actions.why: Both reviews mentioning wifi report evening dropouts or slowness for work calls, and it scores 1 of 5.

authenticity.note: Each flag is a signal for review, not a verdict. Confirm keeps its reviews out of the verified rating and the synthesis; dismiss returns them.

flags.rationale: 5 reviews share near duplicate phrasing: peak Jaccard similarity 0.92 (mean 0.79) against a threshold of 0.55.
5 5-star reviews posted within 2 days (2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05); threshold is 3 within 4 days.
5 reviews share near duplicate meaning: peak cosine similarity 1.00 (mean 0.99) against a threshold of 0.85; 0 of 10 pairs in the group were not caught by word overlap.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'in', 'staff'.
Language resembles reviews written without a stay: p = 0.82 (threshold 0.80). Cues toward deceptive: 'amazing', 'hotel in', 'staff and'; toward truthful: 'michigan', 'by', 'in'.

2 reviews make the same specific claims in different words: 1 of 1 pairs in the group were judged to describe the same things, none of them already joined by the detector's wording or meaning signals. Reviews 10 and 16: Both reviews praise the inn's waterfront/harbor location as a key positive; review 10 adds walkability to dinner and review 16 adds a dated but clean room, but the shared core claim is the same location.

judgments.reason: Both reviews praise the inn's waterfront/harbor location as a key positive; review 10 adds walkability to dinner and review 16 adds a dated but clean room, but the shared core claim is the same location.

thresholds.duplicate_phrasing: Jaccard word overlap at or above 0.55
thresholds.rating_burst: 3 or more same rating reviews within 4 days
thresholds.claim_duplicate: at least 1 shared specific claim, then a model judgment per pair (lenient prompt)

methods.flag_decisions_by: automatic: every flag confirmed without review (evaluation run)
